jlc3dp.name: JLC3DP (JLCPCB 3D printing)
jlc3dp.upload_rules: OBJ numbers read as mm; flat zip; WJP needs OBJ+MTL(Kd 1.0)+PNG; 6-7 MB zips proven, 14-16 MB failed; tick thin-wall risk box on figures

printie.name: Printie
printie.upload_rules: 3MF/STL, PLA/PETG/TPU/ASA/CF, AMS up to 8 colours; never for face products

makerfabs.name: Makerfabs
makerfabs.role: electronics integration (schematic, PCBA, programming, testing, enclosures, pack)
makerfabs.note: Advertised capabilities only — unqualified. Ask: assembled illuminated controller quote.

seeed.name: Seeed Studio Fusion
seeed.role: hardware engineering + e-kits (PCBA, Grove, kitting from 5 sets)
seeed.note: Reachy Mini industrialisation precedent — not one-off proof. Ask: integration + kitting MOQs.

elecrow.name: Elecrow
elecrow.role: turnkey PCBA + sourcing + testing + inventory + pack + dropship; existing contact
elecrow.note: Reframe as modular design family + one reference design. Ask: non-electronic craft extension.

nextsmartship.name: NextSmartShip
nextsmartship.role: Shenzhen fulfilment + order-of-one kitting candidate (no standard MOQ published)
nextsmartship.note: Ask: unique 4-supplier gift-box trial, personalised instruction, per-order SKU.

china-fulfillment.name: China Fulfillment International
china-fulfillment.role: Shenzhen consolidation + branded kits + dispatch alternative
china-fulfillment.note: Ask: competing quote for identical pilot, filmed.

onebookprint.name: OneBookPrint
onebookprint.note: Lead times differ across their pages — demand written turnaround to Shenzhen warehouse.
